Container.Name: ShareDrive-Backend
Container.Overview: ShareDrive web application and API in one container. Build sharedrive:unraid from the repository root with backend/Dockerfile. Requires the sharedrive Docker network and PostgreSQL, Redis, MinIO and ClamAV. HTTP is published on port 8088; your existing reverse proxy manages HTTPS and certificates. Prepare the .env and setup token before applying this template. Startup applies versioned database migrations; baseline legacy db-push installations and back up before upgrades. Runs as UID/GID 1000.

Config.Name: HTTP port
Config.Description: Forward your existing HTTPS reverse proxy to this HTTP port.

Config.Name: Setup token directory
Config.Description: Private persistent setup token; owner UID/GID 1000, directory 0700 and token 0600.

Config.Name: Application port
Config.Description: Fixed internal HTTP port for the web application and API.
